body_lead: Hyderabad: The Telangana govt in partnership with Microsoft, 1M1B Foundation and MeitY Startup Hub launched the Telangana Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence in Hyderabad on Friday. The centre, inaugurated by Telangana IT and industries minister D Sridhar Babu, will train technology and science graduates in Applied AI, Green Pharma, solar energy, electric vehicles and wind energy. It will also connect participants with industry mentors, internships and employment pathways.
